layout.meaning: AI-to-CP hierarchy contrasts output types above a branching evaluation design; C/D/E braces encode scenario membership. Green/red and reliability labels are communication choices, not clinical safety certificates.
layout.arrow_scope: Branches organize evaluations; they do not generate datasets or define a sequential deployed patient pathway.
layout.omissions: Training/calibration/test roles, class references, p formula, strict threshold and truth-only evaluation require Methods/S1/Table S1, not main-figure arrows.
layout.limits: No bar extraction, performance replication or pathology interpretation. Bottom text touches the boundary; source pixels were not repaired.

dependencies_and_gaps.split: S1 p4 reports man-level training/test then proper/calibration splits. Par27/30/33 distinguish fitting from calibration. No patient IDs audited.
dependencies_and_gaps.threshold: Par26, Table S1 and code agree on p_y > 1-c; equality excluded. Class p values are not normalized class probabilities.
dependencies_and_gaps.formula: Table S1 p9 counts N+1 nonconformity scores with >=, including self. functions.R L89-112 uses (# calibration scores < test score + U * # ties)/(n_y+1), U=runif(1), without numerator self/+1. Reversing score direction does not resolve this difference.
dependencies_and_gaps.version: Author v1.0.0 tag resolves to the previously pinned3dd31205commit; this resolves tag identity only. Exact Zenodo archive bytes remain unverified after403, and actual publication-run identity is unknown. Six selected unmodified functions ran in current R4.5.1 on invented inputs; no clinical/demo data or master pipeline ran.
dependencies_and_gaps.policy: Deployment may use set cardinality. Table S1/functions.R L276-300 also use truth-dependent groups, which are not deployment states. Empty excludes truth and is a coverage failure even where a local Error category omits it.
dependencies_and_gaps.review: Par11/S5 p8 assume expert assessment in an experimental collaboration. Non-singleton-to-review is a task illustration, not validated clinical routing. Distributional assumptions and the conflicting implementation remain unverified.

transferable_rules.rule: Separate proper fitting, labeled calibration and truth-free inference; test truth enters only post-hoc evaluation.
transferable_rules.effect: Show fixed-model reuse; forbid calibration/test-to-fit and test-truth-to-p arrows in this inductive workflow.

transferable_rules.rule: Separate cardinality routing from truth-dependent coverage evaluation.
transferable_rules.locators: Par24/26; Par11; Table S1; functions.R L276-300
transferable_rules.effect: Singleton means candidate, not known-correct; two labels mean uncertainty, not two diagnoses; empty retains no label and fails coverage.

transferable_rules.rule: Keep stratum size, less/tie counts, self term and saved random draw explicit when numerical source rules conflict; compare without silently adjudicating. A fixed-case graphic must reject inputs outside its labelled counts.
transferable_rules.locators: functions.R64–112; SupplementTableS1p9; current own numeric/render/guard evidence
transferable_rules.effect: Distinct circle/square p-values with strict threshold and prediction-set strip; test truth supplies only optional evaluation.

boundary_example.change: Strict p_y > epsilon, epsilon=1-c: c=.95 yields epsilon=.05 and {C}; equality excludes B. c=.99 yields epsilon=.01 and {B,C}.
boundary_example.limit: Task inputs only; no p generation, article-result reproduction, coverage or review-efficacy estimate.
